Effective Date: 12/30/2025 Acquisition ID# 36C260-26-AP-1884

DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS

Justification for Single Source Awards IAW FAR 13.106-1 For Over Micro-Purchase Threshold but Not Exceeding the SAT Acquisition Plan Action ID: 36C260-26-AP-1884

1. Contracting Activity: Department of Veterans Affairs, Regional Procurement Office West, Network Contracting Office 20 on behalf of Spokane Medical Center. Funding: 668-26-2-5312-0055

2. Brief Description of Supplies/ Services required and the intended use/Estimated Amount: This is an urgent requirement to replace a module on a Philips EPIQ ultrasound - EPIQ B-Cart Acquisition Module Estimated total

3. Unique characteristics that limit availability to only one source, with the reason no other supplies or services can be used: The requiring facility is in need of an emergency replacement of the module for their EPIQ7 Ultrasound Module. Philips North America is the manufacturer of the EPIQ7 ultrasound unit located at the Spokane VA Medical Center which is used for cardiovascular diagnostics. Due to the complexity of this unit, only Philips can provide the replacement module and replacement service to ensure proper operation of this device. The parts, technology, schematics, and components are only available from Philips. Additionally, there are no back-up ultrasounds for this unit. While this unit is down, cardiology has has had to borrow a unit from another cardiology department, but this borrowed unit is normally in constant use and not available. Without repair of the EPIQ, patients will need to be re-schedule severely affecting patient care.

4. Description of market research conduct ed and results or statement why it was not conducted: Limited market research was conducted because of its emergent nature and to prevent delay in care and impact on veterans. At minimum, we know the equipment requested meets the facilities’ needs. This is a specialized piece of imaging equipment so the market is limited. Only Philips can provide this item and installation thereof.

*** Due to its high impact on patient care, this is an emergency request.*** Effective Date: 12/30/2025 Acquisition ID# 36C260-26-AP-1884
